verdict.rationale: First-party docs say you can install the Mem0 SDK and save and search memories in Python or JavaScript, with a `client.add(messages, user_id=...)` code sample. A published OpenAPI spec backs the API surface the SDKs wrap. missing for 10: detailed SDK reference documentation (package names, versioning, method coverage), any SDK languages beyond Python and JavaScript, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
